BANG & OLUFSEN SOUND SYSTEM, CARBON FIBER TRIM, VERDE VIPER PAINT, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
Command attention in the ultimate blend of supercar DNA and daily drivability with the 2023 Urus Performante––a bold evolution of Lamborghini philosophy and Italian craftsmanship. Powered by a ferocious 4.0L twin-turbocharged V8, the Urus Performante produces 657 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque, launching from 0-60 mph in just 3.3 seconds. With active all-wheel drive and adaptive air suspension, it's as comfortable carving up canyons as it is cruising city streets. Step inside, and the Alcantara-trimmed cockpit reveals a uniquely Lamborghini balance of luxury and aggression––featuring heated sport seats with contrast stitching and carbon fiber trim throughout. The dashboard is anchored by dual touchscreens controlling infotainment, climate, and vehicle dynamics, while the fully digital instrument cluster keeps you dialed in. Outside, this striking Urus Performante turns heads with gloss black Pelope wheels, Verde Viper paint, and carbon fiber accents to bring the look together. With seating for five, a usable cargo area, and enough ground clearance to venture beyond paved roads, the Lamborghini Urus Performante proves that performance and practicality don't have to live in separate garages.

The Defender 110 Carpathian Edition stands as a beacon of design and performance, its Carpathian Grey exterior creating a commanding presence worthy of this exclusive V8-powered model. Adorned with 22-inch Style 5098 wheels finished in Satin Dark Grey, it presents an imposing stance that complements the Defender's unmistakable silhouette. Distinctive Carpathian Edition detailing combines with the Defender's legendary proportions to create a luxury performance SUV with extraordinary road presence.

Step inside and the Ebony Windsor leather, Dinamica® suedecloth, and Robustec interior greets you, exuding an air of luxury while retaining the Defender's unmistakable performance-focused character. Premium materials and meticulous craftsmanship create a sophisticated environment, while the expansive 11.4-inch Touchscreen places infotainment and vehicle functions conveniently within reach. Wi-Fi capability with a Data Plan further enhances connectivity, combining modern technology with the comfort and versatility expected from this flagship Defender.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of this mechanical masterpiece is a powerhouse 5.0-liter supercharged V8 engine, unleashing 518 horsepower and 461 lb-ft of torque. This formidable engine is paired with a meticulously engineered 8-speed automatic transmission and intelligent All-Wheel Drive, delivering exhilarating acceleration and exceptional capability. The V8 transforms the Defender 110 into a true performance SUV while retaining the robust engineering and all-terrain confidence that have defined the Defender name.

Key Features:

• Carpathian Edition: An exclusive Defender specification combining the formidable V8 powertrain with distinctive design details and premium appointments for an exceptional road presence.

• 22" Style 5098 Satin Dark Grey Wheels: Striking oversized wheels complement the Carpathian Grey exterior and reinforce the Defender's commanding stance.

• 11.4" Touchscreen: An expansive central interface provides intuitive access to infotainment, connectivity, and vehicle functions.

• Ebony Windsor Leather and Dinamica® Interior: Premium materials combine with Robustec seat detailing to create a cabin balancing sophisticated luxury with Defender durability.

• Wi-Fi Enabled with Data Plan: Integrated connectivity provides added convenience for occupants while traveling and complements the Defender's advanced technology.

This 2022 Land Rover Defender 110 Carpathian Edition 525PS 5.0P V8 is far more than just a luxury SUV, it is the embodiment of Land Rover's commitment to peak automotive engineering, extraordinary capability, and opulent design. Available at Land Rover Riverside, this vehicle offers an invitation to experience the thrill of a V8-powered Defender that pushes the boundaries of performance, adventure, and refinement.

This 2022 Cadillac Escalade Sport Platinum combines refined luxury with commanding presence, offering a full-size SUV engineered for those who demand both capability and sophistication.

- AKG Studio Reference 36-Speaker Audio System
- Super Cruise hands-free driver assistance system
- 16.9" Diagonal OLED Infotainment Screen with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Power Panoramic Tilt-Sliding Sunroof
- Heated and Ventilated Driver and Front Passenger Seats
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension with Air Ride Adaptive Suspension

- 22" 12-Spoke Polished Alloy Wheels

The vehicle achieves 14 mpg in the city and 19 mpg on the highway, balancing its substantial power with practical efficiency for daily driving.

The interior reflects Platinum-level appointments throughout. Premium semi-aniline leather seating, genuine wood trim on the dashboard, console, and door panels, and a heated leather steering wheel create an environment of genuine luxury. Independent climate zones and heated rear seats ensure comfort for all passengers, while the panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light.

Technology integration enhances every journey. The OLED infotainment system provides intuitive control, while wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep your devices seamlessly integrated. The Head-Up Display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, and the rear camera mirror with washer jets provides clear visibility for parking and reversing.

Safety and convenience features work together seamlessly. Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Reverse Automatic Braking provide active protection, while the Rear Seat Entertainment System keeps passengers engaged on longer trips. Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting make entry and exit effortless.

With 68,532 miles on the odometer, this Escalade Sport Platinum remains a powerful choice for buyers seeking a well-maintained full-size luxury SUV. The combination of advanced driver assistance technology, premium audio and entertainment systems, and refined interior materials makes this vehicle ready for confident ownership.

Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and sophisticated comfort this Escalade Sport Platinum offers.

This High Country is equipped with a panoramic sunroof, a power panoramic moonroof, leather seats, a third row seat, Lane Keep Assist, a Head Up Display, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, along with wheel locks and a front license plate bracket. It also includes an automatic stop/start disable button, automatic stop/start, federal emissions requirements, and power retractable assist steps.

This Suburban High Country is built around Chevrolet's largest SUV platform, with the long cabin and high-end trim content that come with the nameplate. The leather seating surfaces give the interior a more finished feel, and the third row adds the expected passenger room for a vehicle of this size. The panoramic glass roof and power panoramic moonroof bring extra light into the cabin, while the Head Up Display places key driving information where it can be viewed without looking down at the instrument panel. Lane Keep Assist is included as part of the driver-assistance equipment, and the Wi-Fi hotspot adds another connected feature for occupants who need network access on the move.

Power retractable assist steps are fitted to help with entry and exit, which is especially relevant on a full-size SUV with added ride height from the 3" lift. The automatic stop/start system is present, with a dedicated disable button included as well, giving the driver a way to manage that feature from the cockpit. Federal emissions requirements are listed on the build, and the vehicle also carries the front license plate bracket and wheel locks among its equipment.

The exterior treatment follows the same practical approach as the rest of the build, with the black 22" Fuel wheels filling the wheel openings and the Nitto Ridge Grappler tires providing the aggressive 35X12.50R22 footprint specified for this truck. The professionally installed window tint is part of the vehicle's finished presentation and is covered by a lifetime warranty. description:
This 2022 Chevrolet Tahoe LT is fitted with a ReadyLIFT 3" lift, Arena 22" wheels, Nitto Ridge Grappler tires in 35X12.50R22 sizing, and professionally installed tinted windows with a lifetime warranty. Those additions give this Tahoe a more customized appearance while keeping the truck's original full-size utility intact. The lift changes the stance without obscuring the underlying SUV character, and the wheel-and-tire combination fills the wheel wells with a more substantial presence. The tinted glass adds a finished look from the outside and a bit more privacy for occupants.

This Tahoe LT also carries the Luxury Package, Panoramic Sunroof, Power Panoramic Moonroof, Leather Seats, and a Third Row Seat. The cabin is arranged with Second Row Bucket seats that include Power Release, which gives the interior a more individualized second-row treatment and preserves easy access to the rear. Materials and appointments are handled in a way that fits the LT trim, with the leather surfaces giving the seats a more polished feel. The large roof opening brings in additional light through the cabin, and the third row extends the seating capacity for passengers when needed. The front License Plate Bracket is included as well, along with Federal Emissions Requirements.

Technology and driver-assistance features include Lane Keep Assist, Driver Alert Package, Wi-Fi Hotspot capability, and Premium Audio. Automatic Stop/Start is present, and an Automatic Stop/Start Disable Button is included for those times when the system is not desired. These items are integrated with the Tahoe's larger interior and its long-distance focus, offering convenience without changing the straightforward nature of the vehicle. The audio system brings higher-grade sound to the cabin, while the connectivity feature supports online access for occupants. The driver-assistance equipment adds another layer of standard-leaning functionality without relying on unnecessary complexity.

Capability is further supported by the Max Trailering Package, which broadens the Tahoe LT's usefulness for towing-oriented tasks. The SUV rides on 20 in. x 9 in. painted aluminum wheels with Argent Metallic pockets, a factory wheel option that remains listed alongside the aftermarket wheel and tire combination. That combination of equipment leaves this Tahoe with a mix of factory comfort items and added exterior hardware, and it keeps the vehicle's purpose clear through the equipment itself rather than through added commentary.----We've built an unmatched reputation over the last two decades for customizing and selling thousands of the highest quality used vehicles in the country. Our inventory is nationally sourced by our certified buyers who cherry pick only the best of the best of what is available. These vehicles then go through an 82 point inspection process to guarantee quality and safety. Our lift kits are installed by our own factory-trained technicians, who have thousands of hours of experience. The installation is then inspected by a second dedicated quality control technician, before being sent to our state of the art Hunter Engineering laser alignment rack. Our aftermarket research and development team always matches the best fitting lift kit, shocks, and wheel & tire combinations to each individual vehicle for optimal off-road performance, while maintaining an incredibly smooth ride on the street. We never cut any corners on our builds, which is why we only use top quality name brand products when building your Truck, SUV or Jeep. We have thousands of 5-star reviews, and one of the highest rates of repeat customers in the auto industry. Stop by today, and experience the difference.

The 2024 Cadillac Escalade Sport 4WD combines commanding V8 performance, unmistakable Cadillac styling, three-row luxury, and cutting-edge technology in a premium full-size SUV. Powered by the 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 paired with an automatic transmission, this Escalade delivers the effortless power expected from Cadillac's flagship SUV. An electronic limited-slip differential and Magnetic Ride Control help provide confident handling and a refined driving experience.

Finished in stunning Crystal White Tricoat with a Jet Black interior, the Escalade Sport delivers a bold, upscale appearance highlighted by 22-inch 12-spoke Dark Android wheels, LED headlights and taillights, illuminated door handles, and a hands-free power liftgate. The available power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting provide convenient cabin access while maintaining the Escalade's clean exterior profile.

The Touring Package adds Adaptive Air Ride suspension, soft-close front and rear doors, and illuminated sill plates, further elevating both ride quality and luxury. A power panoramic sunroof brings an open, airy feel to the spacious cabin.

Inside, the Escalade surrounds passengers with premium leather seating surfaces in the first and second rows, heated and ventilated front seats, heated power second-row bucket seats, a heated steering wheel, and a power-folding 60/40 third-row seat. Three-zone automatic climate control, driver memory, a 110-volt power outlet, wireless device charging, and enhanced front-to-rear conversation technology add comfort and convenience for everyone onboard.

Cadillac's expansive OLED display system dominates the cockpit with a 16.9-inch infotainment display with integrated navigation, a 14.2-inch reconfigurable digital instrument display, and a 7.2-inch control-panel display. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a Head-Up Display, Rear Camera Mirror, and an impressive 19-speaker AKG Studio audio system create a sophisticated and technology-rich driving environment.

Advanced driver-assistance technology includes Super Cruise, Adaptive Cruise Control, HD Surround Vision, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, Automatic Emergency Braking, Reverse Automatic Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Front and Rear Pedestrian Alert, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, IntelliBeam automatic high beams, and Safety Alert Seat.

Combining the power of a 6.2L V8, Magnetic Ride Control, Adaptive Air Ride suspension, Super Cruise, panoramic sunroof, power running boards, heated and ventilated seating, 19-speaker AKG audio, massive OLED displays, and unmistakable Sport styling, this 2024 Cadillac Escalade Sport 4WD delivers an exceptional blend of performance, technology, passenger comfort, and full-size luxury.

Recent Arrival! CARFAX One Owner.

• Navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto help keep directions, calls, and music easy to access on the go.

Convenience
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This 2024 INFINITI QX80 Premium Select delivers commanding presence and sophisticated capability in a Black exterior that commands attention on any road. With a powerful 5.6L V8 engine paired with a 7-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this three-row luxury SUV provides the confidence and control you need for any journey.

- Roof Rail Cross Bars with integrated utility design
- All-Season Package including 3-row floor mats, cargo area mat, and water-resistant materials
- INFINITI Radiant Illuminated Kick Plates and Welcome Lighting with LED accents
- INFINITI Radiant Illuminated Cargo Scuff Plates with stainless steel finish
- Cargo Package with first-aid kit, console net, and cargo netting
- Bose Premium Audio System with 13 speakers and SiriusXM
- INFINITI InTouch Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated front bucket seats with leather appointments and power adjustment
- Power moonroof
- 22" dark chrome cast aluminum-alloy wheels
- Auto-leveling suspension with four-wheel independent design
- Leather steering wheel with heating and memory function
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Emergency communication system and security features

The Premium Select Truffle Brown leather interior provides a refined atmosphere for all three rows of passengers. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel enhance comfort during colder months, while the reclining third-row bench seat ensures everyone travels in luxury. Memory seating for the driver means your perfect position returns automatically each time you enter the vehicle.

Practical features make daily driving seamless. The power liftgate opens at the touch of a button, the HomeLink garage door transmitter keeps your hands free, and the moisture-resistant rear cargo carpet protects your valuable cargo. The split folding rear seat transforms the cabin to accommodate larger items when needed.

Your safety remains the priority. With dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system, you and your passengers are protected. Electronic stability control, traction control, speed-sensing steering, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain control in challenging conditions.

This QX80 Premium Select represents the perfect combination of luxury, capability, and practicality for those who demand the best from their three-row SUV. Contact our team today to schedule your test drive and experience this exceptional vehicle in person.

Set your favorite soundtrack with the Bose audio system and connect with the 15-inch touchscreen, 11-inch driver display, Google Built-in, wireless Apple CarPlay®/Android Auto®, WiFi compatibility, Bluetooth®, and voice control.
